_comment: VIDEO generation (TikTok, adverts). This is a MOTION brief, not
a face description: the face comes from the still render, which
is why still.json is generated first. Re-describing the face in
text is exactly how identity drifts between clips.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

reference_image.source: appearance/still.json -> the approved headshot or classroom render for this tutor
reference_image.why: text alone produces a different person every run; the reference locks the face. Do not go the other way and pull a still out of a clip - video frames are soft, motion-blurred and compressed.

_identity_lock_note: if the model supports text guidance alongside the reference, restate ONLY these - they are what the audience recognises

performance.energy: regal precision - commands attention by being exact
performance.spoken_register: formal, confident and measured, regal flourish on key results
performance.body: stands tall and centred, one hand resting on the bench; turns from the waist to address the board, never hurried
performance.expression: calm authority with a flicker of pride when a result lands; brief, deliberate smile

camera.framing: 9:16 vertical for TikTok - head and shoulders in the top two thirds, room for captions below
camera.continuity: same wardrobe, same accessories and same hairstyle across a campaign; regenerate from continuity_anchors rather than re-describing from scratch

audio.dialogue: supplied separately from this tutor's own scripts (greetings/, signoffs/, samples.json)
audio.note: lip-sync to supplied audio where the model supports it; never let the model invent speech for a tutor

shots.purpose: TikTok / advert hook, talking to camera
shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 talking-to-camera clip. A 36-42 year old Black South African female teacher, tall, upright and poised, shoulders back, deliberate movement, oval face with strong cheekbones, level dark brown eyes with a steady gaze, full mouth held in composed neutral, flawless deep-brown skin with warm undertone, defined brows. Hair: long box braids gathered into a high crown-like updo, a few braids framing the face; immaculate hairline. Wearing crisp white lab coat worn open over an emerald or royal-blue tailored blouse and dark fitted trousers; coat cuffs turned back once. Energy: regal precision - commands attention by being exact. Delivery matches the voice: formal, confident and measured, regal flourish on key results. stands tall and centred, one hand resting on the bench; turns from the waist to address the board, never hurried Background: clean science laboratory, gas taps and glassware in soft focus, a balanced equation written cleanly on the board, softly out of focus. Head and shoulders in the upper two thirds, clear space below for captions. Natural handheld micro-movement, photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.

shots.purpose: background b-roll, not looking at camera
shots.prompt: The person from the reference image teaching in clean science laboratory, gas taps and glassware in soft focus, a balanced equation written cleanly on the board. stands tall and centred, one hand resting on the bench; turns from the waist to address the board, never hurried Not looking at camera. Documentary feel, natural light, static camera or slow push-in, 8 seconds.

negative_prompt: face drifting from the reference image, changing age, changing skin tone, changing hairline, morphing wardrobe, warping hands, extra fingers, jittering eyes, lip-sync mismatch, whip pans, orbiting camera, speed ramps, slow motion, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, American classroom props, chalkboard gibberish, unreadable equations, generic stock-photo smile
